subject: Aligning Eval Kickoff — timing, success metrics, and prompt scope
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning Eval Kickoff — timing, success metrics, and prompt scope

Hi Alex —

Great to connect earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Objective: run a 3-week evaluation to validate retrieval+LLM assist for clinical note summarization and triage routing.
- Key success criteria we heard: (1) average latency < 1.0s for 256-token responses, (2) top-1 accuracy on routing labels > 92% vs human baseline, (3) prompt set passes defined safety checks.
- Scope for kickoff: demo of integration points, trial plan & roles, and handoff of a starter prompt set for initial evals.

Proposed immediate asks / next steps:
1) Lock an evaluation kickoff slot (45–60 minutes) for a demo + technical deep dive (we'll bring a Solutions Engineer). Two windows we have open: Tue May 26 9:00–10:00 PT or Wed May 27 11:00–12:00 PT — please confirm which works for your team and who will attend.
2) Share any existing sample prompts or a small anonymized dataset for scope (see attachment: clarion-eval-template.xlsx) — this helps Karthik scope the prompt workshop.
3) Any compliance or SSO/KMS constraints we should prep for in advance (SSO provider, IP allowlists, SOC 2 evidence requests).

I've looped in Ben (AE) and Karthik (SE) on CC. If you prefer a different cadence (shorter kickoff + separate tech deep dive), say the word and we can split it.

Attachments: clarion-eval-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — looking forward to locking calendar.

—
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clarionhealth.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@clarionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning Eval Kickoff — timing, success metrics, and prompt scope

Priya —

Thanks for the clear recap. Wed May 27 11:00–12:00 PT works best for our lead engineer (Jamie) and myself. We'll plan for the 60-minute slot.

A couple quick notes from our side:
- We'll attach a redacted prompt list and a 200-record sample in a reply here (we prefer S3 links for the data exchange).
- On compliance: Clarion uses Okta SSO and we require a brief onboarding questionnaire for any third-party handling PHI-adjacent metadata. Can you confirm if Redwood has an SOC 2 report and whether you support IdP-initiated SSO?

I'll upload the sample prompts shortly. If you need an NDA or a DPA before data transfer, let me know and I'll loop in Legal.

Alex / team —

Thanks — we'll mark Wed May 27 11:00–12:00 PT as provisional. Karthik will lead the technical deep dive portion; I will cover trial objectives, measurement plan, and mutual action items.

To make the kickoff high-impact, attached is a short draft charter that outlines roles, timelines, and a suggested prompt-workshop agenda. A few clarifying questions so we come prepared:
- Expected evaluation traffic: do you anticipate steady async traffic (batch of files) or live per-request traffic? This impacts how we size dedicated capacity or the trial config.
- For quality acceptance: is the 92% top-1 your program-level gate or an initial target we'll iterate on?
- Do you have a preferred location for data exchange (S3 bucket or secure Drive)?

Attachments: trial-charter-draft.pdf

I'll send a calendar invite once Alex confirms final attendees.

—

ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0177

Confirmed: Wed May 27 11:00–12:00 PT. Attendees from Clarion: Alex Turner (Product), Jamie Liu (Lead Engineer), Dr. Sara Patel (Clinical Ops).

I've attached an initial sample prompt file (clarion_sample_prompts.txt) — redacted content only. We plan to share the S3 link for the 200-record sample once the DPA/transfer checklist is in place.

On your SOC2 question: please send the SOC 2 summary and a link to your security questionnaire. We use Okta (IdP-initiated SSO) and would like instructions if Redwood supports automatic provisioning.

We look forward to the kickoff — please send the calendar invite and a short pre-read (10–12 slide deck) if you have one.
